title: Work IQ: Context IQ adds agents, skills and content sources to the prompt menu
summary: Hold: the automation beside the agent Block control only retrieves inventory; it cannot block an agent. Microsoft documents a separate preview blocking operation. The roadmap facts and the cited Work IQ overview statements are supported, and the previously rate-limited Microsoft pages were accessible.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to expand Context IQ to discover and select additional agents, skills and content sources while composing prompts.
claims.quote: Expand Context IQ so users can discover and select additional agents, skills, and content sources while composing prompts.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe this specific Context IQ expansion.
claims.quote: Searched: "ExpandedContextIQ"; "Context IQ" "agents" "skills"; "Context IQ" "570854" rollout license agents skills. Read Work IQ overview, Context IQ support article and release-note search excerpts; none describes this expansion.

claims.claim: Context IQ already provides a references menu in Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Use the Context IQ menu to search for and select a Teams channel.

claims.claim: The March 10, 2026 Copilot release notes describe selecting Teams channels to ground Copilot Chat responses.
claims.quote:
## March 10, 2026
You can now search for and select Microsoft Teams channels in Context IQ to ground Copilot Chat prompts in the conversations and content that matter most.

claims.claim: Typing / in the compose box opens the references menu.
claims.quote: To reference a specific piece of information, type **/** and begin typing the people, file, meeting, or email you wish to link.

claims.claim: The existing references menu supports files, people, meetings and emails.
claims.quote: People, Microsoft 365 files, meetings, and emails are accessible through tabs.

claims.claim: The existing menu supports Teams chats and channels.
claims.quote: Copilot suggests your relevant Teams group and meeting chats based on recent activity and number of participants under the **Chats** tab. Copilot also displays your recently used Teams channels under the **Channels** tab.

claims.claim: The existing menu supports SharePoint sites and lists.
claims.quote: Copilot displays SharePoint sites, pages, and lists that you've recently interacted with or were shared with you. Select a site to scope your prompt to its contents.

claims.claim: The existing references menu supports content from Copilot connectors.
claims.quote: You can now ground your Copilot prompts on third-party data using your organization's Graph Connector content, accessible from the references menu in Copilot Chat.

claims.claim: The cited Context IQ support article does not list agents or skills as reference types.
claims.quote: Searched: "Context IQ" "agents" "skills". Read the full cited support article: its reference sections cover people, meetings, Teams content, emails, files and images, SharePoint sites and connectors, not agents or skills.

### Work IQ turned on
To add links to Microsoft 365 files, reference people, and include calendar events and emails, follow these steps:

claims.claim: The agent Block control is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Block.
claims.quote:
Select **Agents** > **All agents**.
In the **All agents** page, select an agent from the list of agents.
In the agent details pane that opens, immediately under the agent's name, select **Block** or **Unblock**.

claims.claim: GET /v1.0/copilot/admin/catalog/packages is the automation counterpart beside the control deciding whether agents are blocked.
claims.quote:
Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block
claims.fix: Replace controls[1].api.call with 'POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block' and its docs URL with https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/api/admin-settings/package/copilotpackage-block. Replace the row's Graph-call note with 'The block operation is preview, requires a Microsoft Agent 365 licence and delegated CopilotPackages.ReadWrite.All permission, and is not supported for production use.' Make the rendered row consistent. Keep the existing GET call only in the prose as an inventory operation, not as the automation for blocking.
